findings.current: “I knew you’d say that, so he told me not to say anything, even if it was you, Benefactor.”
findings.defect: Cheongpung says the Slaughter Saint anticipated Taekyung’s response, not that Cheongpung anticipated it.
findings.rationale: 아시고 refers to the elder who gave the instruction.
findings.replacement: “He knew you’d say that, so he told me not to say anything, even to you, Benefactor.”
findings.source: 그렇게 말씀하실 줄 아시고, 상대가 설령 은인이라 할지라도 함구하랬어요.

findings.current: “Wow, that’s amazing. I wonder if he also told me to keep quiet if you tried to talk me into it with Sound Transmission.”
findings.defect: Cheongpung is reporting an instruction, not wondering whether one exists. Taekyung proposes using Sound Transmission; the warning anticipates that proposal rather than persuasion conducted through it.
findings.rationale: 함구하랬어요 states what the Slaughter Saint told him; 전음으로 말하면 괜찮다고 describes Taekyung’s proposed exception.
findings.replacement: “Wow, that’s amazing. He even told me to keep quiet if you tried to convince me it would be fine to tell you by Sound Transmission.”
findings.source: 우와, 신기하다. 혹시 은인께서 전음으로 말하면 괜찮다고 꼬드겨도 함구하랬어요.

findings.current: He said he’d kill anyone who found out.
findings.defect: The threat targets Cheongpung if he talks, not people who learn the secret.
findings.rationale: 말하면 makes speaking the condition; Cheongpung is the person being warned.
findings.replacement: He said he’d kill me if I said anything.

findings.current: “……I’ll just pretend I didn’t hear anything.”
findings.defect: Taekyung declines to hear the secret; he does not pretend to forget something already disclosed.
findings.rationale: 안 들을게 refers to not hearing the account Cheongpung has withheld.

findings.current: So he wanted to look into things more closely by infiltrating the Kunlun Sect.
findings.defect: “Wanted to” reduces an intended infiltration to a desire, weakening the attempted-versus-completed distinction made in the next line.
findings.rationale: 잠입하려고 하셨죠 expresses what he was about to do; the following sentence contrasts that with having done it.
findings.replacement: So he was going to infiltrate the Kunlun Sect to investigate further.
findings.source: 그래서 더욱 자세히 파고들기 위해 곤륜파 내부로 잠입하려고 하셨죠.

findings.current: Little Grandpa must have felt it, too, because we decided to return with the monsters who were coming down the mountain.
findings.defect: The Slaughter Saint makes the decision, not the pair jointly; they blend into the descending monsters rather than merely travel with them.
findings.rationale: 되돌아오기로 하셨어요 assigns the decision to the elder, while 틈에 섞여 describes hiding among the monsters.
findings.replacement: Little Grandpa must have felt it too, because he decided we should slip in among the monsters that happened to be coming down the mountain and head back.
findings.source: 작은 할아버지께서도 그걸 느끼셨는지, 때마침 하산하는 괴물들의 틈에 섞여 되돌아오기로 하셨어요.

summary: Several lines change who knew, spoke, or made a decision; two also alter how the secrecy warning works.
